content: Arjun Reddy contacted agent Ravi Menon expressing shock and concern over his health policy (HP-123456) expiring on March 10th without prior notification. Ravi apologized for the oversight, confirmed the expiration was due to non-payment, and provided instructions and attached documents (invoice and reinstatement form) detailing how to pay the outstanding premium and reinstatement fee to restore the policy.

action_items: Pay outstanding premium amount and reinstatement fee
Fill out and submit the reinstatement form
